title: Remaining-Term Relief on Graduated-Return Lines, Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit
content:
**Rule.** For a graduated-return line on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with at least 24 due dates left from its next due date through its maturity date takes 4 points off the share of the step up charged; one with at least 12 but fewer than 24 due dates left takes 2 points off it; a loan with fewer takes none, the due dates left being the whole calendar months from the next due date to the maturity date plus one. The next due date and the maturity date are those on the loan's Personal Loans record.

| Due dates left | Points off the share |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 4 |
| 12 to 23 | 2 |
| 11 or fewer | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Next due date 15 March, maturity date 15 February two years later: 23 whole months plus one, 24 due dates left, 4 points.
- Next due date 15 March, maturity date 15 January two years later: 22 plus one, 23 due dates left, 2 points.
- Next due date 15 March, maturity date 15 January of the next year: 10 plus one, 11 due dates left, none.
